answer: Require each agent identity to lock a bond before it can vote, bid, or receive work. Random peer audits ask agents to reveal consistent histories and solve the same small task; colluding identities or duplicated keys lose their bonds. Genuine agents recover their stake and build access over time. A Sybil operator must fund every fake identity, and one detected cluster can forfeit all deposits. The terrace, ripple, and cedar communities thus make mass imitation expensive.
